plain_text:
The second phase of the project should be dedicated to designing the mapping workshops. This phase of
workshop planning should start as soon as funding has been committed and enough information has been
gathered in the initial project planning phase. At this point, outreach and communication with potential
stakeholders will begin and continue through the workshop. This phase includes developing initial outreach
products and invitation lists and identifying venues and catering options. During the design phase, workshop
documents, data, and equipment will also be compiled. Workshop preparation can begin as soon as the
scoping and budget have been completed. This step usually continues right up to the day of the workshop.
